questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Account)-[:HELD_BY]->(c:Customer), (a)-[:OPENED_AT]->(b:Branch) WHERE c.cif_number = '0001000025' RETURN a.account_key AS account_key, a.account_natural_key AS account_number, a.product_name AS product_name, b.branch_name AS branch_name
questions.text: What accounts does customer 0001000025 hold? For each, the product name and the name of the branch it is maintained at.

questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Call)-[:INITIATED_BY]->(cu:Customer), (c)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:Agent) WHERE cu.cif_number = '0001000025' RETURN a.agent_user_id AS agent_user_id, a.agent_name AS agent_name, count(DISTINCT c.conversation_id) AS call_count ORDER BY call_count DESC
questions.text: Which agents handled calls from customer 0001000025, and how many of that customer's calls did each handle?

questions.cypher: MATCH (c1:Customer)<-[:MADE_BY]-(t1:CardTransaction)-[:TRANSACTED_WITH]->(m:Merchant)<-[:TRANSACTED_WITH]-(t2:CardTransaction)-[:MADE_BY]->(c2:Customer) WHERE c1.cif_number = '0001000025' AND c2.cif_number = '0001000021' AND t1.is_purchase = true AND t2.is_purchase = true RETURN DISTINCT m.merchant_id AS merchant_id, m.merchant_name AS merchant_name ORDER BY merchant_name
questions.text: Which merchants has customer 0001000025 bought from that customer 0001000021 has also bought from?

questions.cypher: MATCH (ct:CardTransaction)-[:MADE_BY]->(c:Customer)<-[:HELD_BY]-(a:Account)-[:OPENED_AT]->(b:Branch) WHERE ct.merchant_id = 'MID000100000' RETURN b.branch_name AS branch_name, count(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customers ORDER BY customers DESC
questions.cypher_why: no column holds customers (1 of 2 match)
questions.text: Customers who bought at Main Street Pharmacy (merchant MID000100000) bank at which branches? Count the distinct customers by the name of the branch where their accounts are maintained.

questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Call)-[:INITIATED_BY]->(cu:Customer), (c)-[:ROUTED_TO]->(q:Queue), (c)-[:PROCESSED_AT]->(s:ContactCenterSite) WHERE cu.segment = 'private' RETURN q.queue_name AS queue_name, s.site_name AS site_name, count(c) AS calls ORDER BY calls DESC
questions.text: For calls from private-segment customers, which queues were they routed through and which sites serviced them? Count the calls by queue name and site name.

questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agent)<-[:HANDLED_BY]-(c1:Call)-[:INITIATED_BY]->(cu:Customer)<-[:INITIATED_BY]-(c2:Call)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(o:Agent) WHERE a.agent_user_id = '9143e7f7-8e11-6904-c98e-fb076ea611a1' AND o.agent_user_id <> a.agent_user_id RETURN o.agent_user_id AS other_agent_user_id, o.agent_name AS other_agent_name, count(DISTINCT cu.customer_key) AS shared_customers ORDER BY shared_customers DESC
questions.text: Which other agents also handled calls from the customers that agent 9143e7f7-8e11-6904-c98e-fb076ea611a1 served? For each other agent, how many of those customers they share.

questions.cypher_why: The graph has no 'product line' property. Account only has product_family, product_code and product_name, and the bank's own SQL takes product_line from a customer_product_holdings table that is not modeled in this graph. Substituting product_family or product_name would answer a different question than the one asked, so no query is written. (The Tulsa site itself is identifiable via ContactCenterSite site_id 'TUL' or Call.site_id.)
questions.text: For customers who called the Tulsa Contact Center, which product lines do their accounts belong to? Count distinct customers by product line.

questions.cypher: MATCH (t:DepositTransaction)-[:POSTED_TO]->(a:Account)-[:HELD_BY]->(c:Customer), (a)-[:OFFERS]->(p:Product) WHERE c.segment = 'affluent' RETURN p.product_line AS product_line, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC
questions.text: For all deposit transactions, of every type, on accounts owned by affluent customers, what is the total transaction amount by the product line of the account?

questions.cypher: MATCH (t:CardTransaction)-[:MADE_BY]->(c:Customer)<-[:INITIATED_BY]-(call:Call) WHERE t.merchant_id = 'MID000100000' AND t.txn_type = 'PURCH' AND call.is_account_closure_call = true RETURN c.segment AS segment, count(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customers ORDER BY customers DESC
questions.text: Customers who made card purchases at Main Street Pharmacy (merchant MID000100000) and also called the contact center about closing an account — how many are there, by customer segment?

questions.cypher: MATCH (t:CardTransaction)-[:MADE_BY]->(c:Customer), (t)-[:TRANSACTED_WITH]->(m:Merchant), (t)-[:CHARGED_TO]->(a:Account) WHERE c.cif_number = '0001000025' AND t.is_purchase = true RETURN m.merchant_name AS merchant_name, a.product_name AS account_product_name, count(t) AS purchases ORDER BY purchases DESC
questions.text: For card purchases made by customer 0001000025, which merchants were they at, and on which of the customer's accounts were they charged? Give the merchant name, the account's product name and the number of purchases.
